TEXT: The day after my exchange with Saori.
I received a mail saying, "I am really grateful for yesterday".

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Mail? ...From Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Since it's about yesterday, it must be regarding the goods?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Let's see what it says...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Thank you for yesterday. ＠ω＠ノシ

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A mail that's completely turning me off from the get go!
Can't she use emoticons like a normal high school girl would?
Well, whatever, moving on.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: After that, I flew into the sky.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Her message's also flying.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: The feeling of lightness, and feet not touching the ground... Do you know of it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: That feeling is also similar to that of a mother who lost her child.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Yes, like myself who parted with my treasures...
What's with this strange prose? What's she trying to tell me?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: When I came to, I was staring at an unknown ceiling.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I only heard later that I had collapsed on the train platform.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Because of that, a few trains had to stop...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Did you meet any problems on the way home?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Because I was worried about this, I sneaked out of the ward to send this message.
Sneaked out of the ward...
Does that mean... She fainted and got sent to the hospital?!
And if she sent this mail, that means she's outside the ward!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Pick up, pick up...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's no use...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh! It connected!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hello, Saori?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kyousuke-shi...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: You've seen my mail?
Oh... This classy voice... That Saori... She uses it occasionally on the phone... But no matter how many times I hear it, I'm still not used to it...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: That mail was a mistake, so please forget about it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Which hospital are you at now?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: You won't listen, will you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Of course.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: *sigh*...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Yokohama University Hospital.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yokohama City University Hospital, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hold on, I'll be right there!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Eh?! But! Here is...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If a mother gets separated with her child...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Then let them meet!
This is how I read Saori's mail as...
"I got so worried about the goods with you that I fainted. Please return them to me after all."
...Then, I have no choice but to go, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Saori!!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...You really came, Kyousuke-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yup, got a problem with it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: No. I only feel happy about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: However, I can't agree with raising your voice in the hospital.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ugh... You're right...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Well... This is a private room, so we won't be bothering other people.
Hmm? She laughed...
What's this? She's in better spirits than I thought.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Anyway, why did you get hospitalized?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You wrote that you fainted on the train platform in the mail. Did you bump your head or something?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: No, I simply got lightheaded due to overwork.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Lightheaded due to overwork?
Can it be that her spirit worsened because she parted with her otaku goods?
No no, it can't be that.
Is what I thought... But this is Saori...
I looked at the backpack that I brought.
Inside it were the otaku goods Saori entrusted me with.
Saori passed it to me as she could only have asked me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kyousuke-shi, that's...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, nothing... This is...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's just something I brought along by mistake!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Therefore please don't mind it one bit at all, no worries!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kyousuke-shi...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Thank you very much for specially making your way here. But, 【I'm completely fine now】.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Yes, seeing your face is enough to make me feel better!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Saori... Those goods...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I should return them to you after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Why?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why you ask...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Because they're important to you? Because you didn't actually want to part with them?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: That is unrelated to the present situation.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Also, I want you to hold on to them by all means.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Say, Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Something really did happen.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I'm simply exhausted. Summer Comiket's about to start, so I have my hands full.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: But I'm fine now!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see. That's good, then.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Kyousuke-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I have a request.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Could you keep this hospitalization a secret from Kiririn-shi and Kuroneko-shi?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh? Why?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: They would want to come visit you if they knew you were hospitalized.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: That's why I would rather you kept quiet about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I feel really bad that I have caused you trouble as a result.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: And I can't let those two worry about me too...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I understand your feelings, but are you really okay with that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: There weren't any problems from the medical examination.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Could you keep this a secret between the two of us?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, if you put it like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I am indebted to you, Kyousuke-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: My deepest apologies for all the troubles I caused you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's all right. "Troubles"? Don't act so reserved.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: But...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That much isn't "trouble" for me! Maybe if we were strangers...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: We're friends, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...haha.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hahahaha, indeed we are!
As I saw Saori laughing merrily, I thought...
No matter who, friends are great!
